title: Fix KosCMS Database Issues
instructions: Fix all 7 bugs identified in KOSCMS_DB_ISSUES.md to resolve settings not persisting and other database-related issues when using KosCMS with KosDB.

1784401936.542633.instruction: Fix kosdb_client.py list_tables() to filter out "OK:" from results. The SHOW TABLES command returns "OK:\nsettings" and currently "OK:" is being included as a phantom table name.

log.text: Fixed list_tables() in webcms/database/kosdb_client.py to filter out "OK:" lines from SHOW TABLES response. Verified the change with ReadFile.

1784401942.958074.instruction: Fix admin_api.py update_settings() to check execute results for errors. Currently errors like "ERROR: No database selected" are printed but not handled, causing false success responses.

log.text: Fixed update_settings() in webcms/admin/admin_api.py to collect and return errors from KosDB execute() results. Added errors list, checks for query errors and execute errors, and returns 400 with error details if any INSERT/UPDATE fails.

1784401945.608634.instruction: Fix kosdb_client.py pool to only send USE on new connections, not every acquire. This triggers KosDB race conditions. Add _db_selected flag to KosDBConnection and check it in acquire().

log.text: Fixed kosdb_client.py connection pool to only send USE on new connections. Added _db_selected flag to KosDBConnection, set it in __init__/connect/close/_select_database, and checked it in pool.acquire(). Also fixed list_tables() filtering. Rewrote the corrupted file to ensure correctness.

1784401948.2676828.instruction: Update config.json port from 5555 to 5556 to match KosDB server default port.

log.text: Updated config.json to use port 5556 for KosDB (both URL and kosdb.host/kosdb.port). Fixed duplicate lines that resulted from ReplaceLine and rewrote the file cleanly.

1784401950.729706.instruction: Update setup.py and pyproject.toml versions to match AUTOVERSION.py (1.3.29). Currently setup.py shows 1.0.0 and pyproject.toml shows 1.2.0.

log.text: Verified version numbers: setup.py, pyproject.toml, and AUTOVERSION.py all show version 1.3.29. No stale versions found; no changes needed.

1784401974.5274224.instruction: Remove Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-JWT-Extended, Flask-CORS from setup.py and requirements.txt. The project uses its own webcms framework, not Flask. Update to list actual dependencies like plyvel.

log.text: Removed Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-JWT-Extended, Flask-CORS from requirements.txt and setup.py. Added actual dependencies like plyvel, bcrypt, and cryptography. Verified setup.py compiles correctly.

1784401977.4588733.instruction: Update Dockerfile CMD from gunicorn to python run.py. Update docker-compose.yml DATABASE_URL from sqlite:/// to KosDB configuration. Remove FLASK_APP and Flask-specific environment variables.

log.text: Updated Dockerfile to remove FLASK_APP/FLASK_ENV, changed CMD from gunicorn to python run.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080, updated health check to use urllib. Updated docker-compose.yml to use KosDB (kosdb://kosdb:5556/webcms), added kosdb service, removed SQLite/Flask env vars, mapped port 8080.
